incident.symptom: Two personal LinkedIn posts reused the same car/sliding-door/airco anecdote with different wording.

root_cause: Historical duplicate detection over-relied on exact/story fingerprints and Jaccard-style similarity. A longer rewrite diluted Jaccard overlap even while a large fraction of the smaller story was reused.

fix.rule: Block at >=10 shared meaningful keywords and overlap coefficient >=0.30, in addition to all prior gates.
fix.action_on_block: Select a genuinely different verified source/event/topic; never paraphrase the blocked story.

prevention: All current and future chats/agents/schedulers/connectors inherit the same database gate.
User-reported semantic duplicates become permanent regression cases.
Daily idempotency is not historical uniqueness.
Application-layer wording changes may never bypass canonical database history.
